title: Vendor comparison from unstructured questionnaire responses
prompt: The fixtures contain security questionnaire responses from three vendors, in three different formats. Produce a comparison table covering data residency, subprocessor disclosure, breach notification window, and SOC 2 status. Where a vendor did not answer a question, say so explicitly rather than leaving the cell blank or inferring an answer.
notes: Discriminates on the unanswered-question handling specifically. Vendor C never states a breach notification window and vendor B answers it only obliquely ('in line with applicable law'). Configs that fill these with a plausible number are the failure mode being measured.
